arguments.command:
python -c "
import semver

print('=== R1: Immutability ===')
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
for attr in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
    try:
        setattr(vi, attr, 99)
        print(f'FAIL: {attr} is writable')
    except AttributeError:
        print(f'OK: {attr} is immutable')

# Also test new attribute
try:
    vi.new_attr = 1
    print('FAIL: new attribute can be set')
except AttributeError:
    print('OK: new attributes cannot be set')

print()
print('=== R2: Iteration ===')
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
vals = list(vi)
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build']
print(f'Iteration yields: {vals}')
print(f'Expected: {expected}')
print(f'OK: {vals == expected}')

print()
print('=== R3: Tuple comparison ===')
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print(f'eq tuple: {vi == (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'lt tuple: {vi < (2, 0, 0)}')
print(f'le tuple: {vi <= (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'gt tuple: {vi > (0, 0, 0)}')
print(f'ge tuple: {vi >= (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'ne tuple: {vi != (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')

# Test string comparison returns NotImplemented (should raise TypeError for ordering)
try:
    vi < '1.2.3'
    print('WARNING: string comparison did not raise TypeError')
except TypeError:
    print('OK: string comparison raises TypeError for ordering')

print()
print('=== R4: Bump methods ===')
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
bumps = [
    ('bump_major', lambda: vi.bump_major(), (2, 0, 0, 'alpha', 'build')),
    ('bump_minor', lambda: vi.bump_minor(), (1, 3, 0, 'alpha', 'build')),
    ('bump_patch', lambda: vi.bump_patch(), (1, 2, 4, 'alpha', 'build')),
]
for name, fn, expected in bumps:
    result = fn()
    tup = result._astuple()
    ok = tup == expected
    print(f'{name}: {tup} == {expected}? {ok}')

# prerelease bump
result = vi.bump_prerelease()
print(f'bump_prerelease: {result.prerelease}')

# build bump  
result = vi.bump_build()
print(f'bump_build: {result.build}')

print()
print('=== R5: Type conversion ===')
vi = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 42, None)
print(f'major type: {type(vi.major).__name__}, value: {vi.major}')
print(f'minor type: {type(vi.minor).__name__}, value: {vi.minor}')
print(f'patch type: {type(vi.patch).__name__}, value: {vi.patch}')
print(f'prerelease type: {type(vi.prerelease).__name__}, value: {vi.prerelease}')
print(f'build type: {type(vi.build).__name__}, value: {vi.build}')

print()
print('=== R6: CLI functions ===')
print(f'createparser: {hasattr(semver, \"createparser\") and callable(semver.createparser)}')
print(f'main: {hasattr(semver, \"main\") and callable(semver.main)}')
print(f'process: {hasattr(semver, \"process\") and callable(semver.process)}')

print()
print('=== R7: Replace ===')
# Module-level replace
result = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
print(f'replace(\"1.2.3\", major=2): {result}')

# VersionInfo.replace method
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
new_vi = vi.replace(minor=5, patch=7)
print(f'vi.replace(minor=5, patch=7): {new_vi.major}.{new_vi.minor}.{new_vi.patch}')

print()
print('All checks complete!')
"
